dialogues.speaker: Shikishima
dialogues.text: Captain, tell us a story about the other nations, will you?

dialogues.speaker: Kaneda
dialogues.text: Not long ago, we had a merchant from Mondstadt come in with Dandelion Wine. It was my first time drinking it, so I bought a huge batch of the stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Kaneda
dialogues.text: They say that Mondstadt's home to a huge winery. That true, Captain? I'd love to go see it if I get the chance...
